contact_pair_calibration_verified.reason: scope boundary: this candidate package intentionally leaves contact_pair calibration unverified

contact_pair_rows_observed.reason: representative contact rows may be inspected for frame, IDs, and time, but they do not establish contact-pair calibration or force sign

contract_sources_present.reason: required pure contracts and specifications are locally hashed

frame_sign_and_units.reason: frame/unit/sign declarations require explicit local vectors and transforms

independent_calibration_input.reason: an explicit independent_reference declaration and separate raw known-load source are required

known_loads_and_sensor_vectors.reason: known_load_n, force/torque vectors, and sensor_valid require explicit local rows; summaries cannot satisfy this condition

local_raw_measurements_present.reason: at least one raw measurement artifact is local, hash verified, and has explicit rows

method_output_excluded.reason: method summaries are explicitly tagged excluded and never used as measurements

object_body_geom_attribution.reason: body/body-geom binding is checked on local body-channel rows; object/contact attribution remains a separate audit

timestamp_dt_resolution.reason: raw timestamps and within-stream adjacent dt checks are available, but explicit resolution/noise repeats are still required
